A protected number must HOLD-OR-IMPROVE: skeleton pages>=50%/>=75% and mean up-or-equal; compare_structure exact up / EXTRA down-or-equal / missing down-or-equal; body_any down-or-equal (a documented net-positive over-capture cost may raise it — judge on the skeleton); structural_clean up-or-equal / leak down-or-equal; tags 100%; flipcard divergence 0; speechbubble defect 0. ack_todo_lines is NOT protected.
